items.html: And we shall explain their matter. Behold, it is known that they are Bina and Tevuna, and sometimes they are included in one Partzuf, and sometimes they are divided. And behold, at the time of the coupling of AVI to bring forth this image of the Mochin, Bina and Tevuna are included, and likewise Aba and Yeshsut. And there is no need to elaborate, since from Ima we shall understand Aba.
